heading: Order update
introGeneric: There is an update on your order.
closingGeneric: Thank you for shopping with us.
closingPlaced: You can review your order in your account.
introPaid: We have received payment for your order.
closingPaid: We will notify you when it ships.
introPaymentFailed: We could not process your payment.
closingPaymentFailed: Please return to checkout to try another payment method.
introConfirmed: Your order has been confirmed and will be prepared shortly.
introShipped: Your order is on its way.
closingShipped: Track your shipment using the details below.
introDelivered: Your order has been marked as delivered.
closingDelivered: We hope you enjoy your purchase.
closingCancelled: If you have questions, contact the store.
introRefunded: A refund has been processed for your order.
closingRefunded: It may take a few business days to appear on your statement.
subjectAbandonedCart: You left items in your cart — {companyName}
introAbandonedCart: You still have items waiting in your cart.
closingAbandonedCart: Complete checkout when you are ready.
introGiftCard: Your gift card code(s) are ready.
closingGiftCard: Keep these codes safe — they are your store credit.
introDigital: Your digital purchases are ready to download.
closingDigital: Links expire according to the product download policy.
introReturnApproved: Your return request has been approved.
closingReturnApproved: Follow any return instructions from the store.
introReturnRejected: Your return request was not approved.
closingReturnRejected: Contact the store if you need more information.
introNewOrderMerchant: A new product order was placed.
closingNewOrderMerchant: Open the admin panel to fulfill it.
introLowStock: Inventory has fallen below the reorder point.
closingLowStock: Restock soon to avoid selling out.
